headline: Holiday fundraiser tickets at $20 each, Santa parade and memory tree events, and a $12958.23 financial report.
summary: Ricky Lee reports the Dec 4 event at Spear Post runs 7:00 PM to 11:00 PM, with proceeds going to Wreaths Across America. Other items include a Vietnam Veterans Plaza cleanup, a Nov 28 truck decorating session, and updates from VFW 545, Legion 331, and BVV.
items: Ricky Lee's Dec 4 event at Spear Post, 7:00 PM to 11:00 PM
Tickets for the Dec 4 event, $20.00 each, with all proceeds to Wreaths Across America
Santa parade on Nov 29, line up at 12:00
Decorate truck on Nov 28 at 8:00 AM at Cory's garage
Decorate memory tree after the truck
Memory tree on Sunday, Nov 29, at 5:00 at Veterans Park
Swim on Sunday, Nov 15, for Wreaths Across America, thanks to Brian
Vietnam Veterans Plaza: Chuck and Cory cleaned it the day before Veterans Day, and Nic cleaned it up later; discussion of what can be done
Legion 331 update on what's going on
